cards.title: Balance the curiosity gap in Reel hooks
cards.claim: A hook can lose viewers if it is so vague that the benefit is unclear or so specific that it reveals the rest of the Reel.
cards.action: Create an information gap that gives viewers enough context to understand the reward for continuing, without explaining the full Reel in the hook.
applies_when: Writing opening hooks for Instagram Reels
The hook is intended to create curiosity and encourage continued viewing
do_not_use_when: The hook leaves viewers "lost and confused" about the benefit or reward
The hook already makes the rest of the Reel predictable
unknowns: No testing method or performance threshold is provided
The passage does not establish that this works for every audience or niche
evidence_quotes: "Basically, you've created too much curiosity, too much ambiguity. It's too confusing or too vague."
"they have no idea what the benefit or the reward is for making said jump."
"there's such little information that is left out of that hook. I know what the rest of the reel is going to be about."
"essentially what you're doing is you're creating an information gap that people feel like it needs to be closed."

cards.title: Lead with a concrete, relatable outcome
cards.claim: Outcome-based hooks present a result first; the passage argues that concrete proof and realistic numbers can make viewers more likely to continue watching.
cards.action: Open with the outcome, using specific and concrete proof or results; use realistic numbers when they are more relatable to the intended audience.
applies_when: Creating outcome-based hooks for Instagram Reels
You have a result or proof point that can be stated at the start
do_not_use_when: The result is presented at a scale your followers are likely to see as unrealistic for themselves
unknowns: No evidence is provided for a particular numerical threshold
Results may vary by audience and topic
evidence_quotes: "Hook template number four is outcomebased hooks. Like the name implies, you are leading with the outcome."
"The more specific and concrete you can get in the proof or in the results that you're giving, the more likely people are to stick around and watch."
"It can actually be just as, if not more effective to use more relatable numbers that are more realistic"
"a lot of my followers are probably going to scroll away because it's unrealistic, or at least they believe it's unrealistic for them."

cards.title: Call out the intended viewer directly
cards.claim: Direct-address hooks identify the ideal Reel viewer at the beginning; the passage says viewers who identify with the callout may keep watching.
cards.action: At the beginning of the Reel, directly name or describe the ideal viewer.
applies_when: The Reel is intended for a definable audience segment
Creating a direct-address hook for Instagram Reels
unknowns: No comparison data is provided against broader hooks
The passage does not specify how narrow an audience description should be
